description: Two identical WeWork debits (same date, amount, text) are both real because the ledger has two 850.00 WeWork bills; both match. Two identical Blue Bottle charges with only one ledger entry: the later bank line is a possible_duplicate. Two Stripe payouts share text and amount but differ in date, so they are not duplicates and each matches its own ledger payout.
notes: Bank rows 2 and 3 are interchangeable; pairing 2->3 and 3->2 is equally correct. Not an ambiguous_match because both ledger entries are consumed either way.
